description: This file defines the LiteralAILogger class used for logging steps and events to the LiteralAI observability platform. It includes methods for logging success and failure events both synchronously and asynchronously, batching logs, and preparing GraphQL queries for ingestion. The class is tailored for integration with the LiteralAI API, including configuration options like API keys, environment info, and batch handling.

classes.name: LiteralAILogger
classes.description: A logger class that sends log events and batch data to the LiteralAI platform, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations, with batching, error handling, and detailed payload preparation.

methods.name: __init__( self, literalai_api_key=None, literalai_api_url="https://cloud.getliteral.ai", env=None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the logger with API URL, API key, environment, and sets up HTTP clients and configurations.

methods.name: log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a successful event synchronously, appending it to the batch and sending if batch size is reached.

methods.name: log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a failure event synchronously, appending it to the batch and sending if batch size is reached.

methods.name: _send_batch(self)
methods.description: Sends the accumulated batch of logs to the LiteralAI API via a GraphQL mutation.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a successful event asynchronously, appending to the queue and flushing if batch size is reached.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a failure event asynchronously, appending to the queue and flushing if batch size is reached.

methods.name: async_send_batch(self)
methods.description: Asynchronously sends the current batch to the LiteralAI API via a GraphQL mutation.

methods.name: dict _prepare_log_data(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Prepares the structured log payload from given event data, including model response details and metadata.

methods.name: _steps_query_variables_builder(self, steps)
methods.description: Builds GraphQL variable definitions for a batch of steps.

methods.name: _steps_ingest_steps_builder(self, steps)
methods.description: Constructs the GraphQL mutation string to ingest log steps.

methods.name: _steps_query_builder(self, steps)
methods.description: Builds the complete GraphQL mutation string for adding steps.

methods.name: _steps_variables_builder(self, steps)
methods.description: Generates a dictionary of variables for the GraphQL mutation based on log steps.
